start: The app's first page, Today (address /), a gym with members, signed in as owner

user_sees: Title "Today" with today's date under it; on top what is waiting ("Needs you"), then the big quick-action buttons
must_not: Yesterday's date; the gym name repeated as the title

user_sees: "Today's collection" with "This month {amount}", "Active members" ("With a running plan"), "Ending today" ("Last day of their plan"), "Ending in 1-3 days", "Ending in 4-7 days", "Ending in 8-15 days", "Expired", "Fees due" with "{n} members", "Birthdays today" ("Send a wish"), "Came in today" ("Open the register"), "Enquiries to call" ("Follow-ups due")
must_not: A cancelled receipt counted in the collection; a member counted in two "Ending" tiles; fees of an archived member dropped from "Fees due"

steps.action: Tap a tile, for example "Ending in 1-3 days"
user_sees: The Members list with exactly the people the tile counted
must_not: A list longer or shorter than the tile's number

steps.action: Go back and tap a quick-action button
user_sees: The job opens at once (for example the Add member form)
must_not: A button for a page this login may not open

steps.action: Scroll to "Talk to these members", "Money to collect" and "Losing the habit"
user_sees: Short lists with "See all"; when empty: "Nobody to follow up", "Everyone has paid" / "No member has dues.", "Everybody is training"
must_not: A member who left years ago in "Talk to these members"; more than six rows under "Money to collect"

start: Today on a Monday: the card "Last week at your gym"

user_sees: The card "Last week at your gym" with "Send last week’s money, plans sold and check-ins to yourself or your partner on WhatsApp." and the button "Share on WhatsApp"
must_not: The card on other days; the card shown to a front-desk login

user_sees: WhatsApp opens with last week's numbers typed in; the owner picks who gets it
must_not: A message sent by itself; this week's numbers; a member's name or number in the text

start: Today: WhatsApp a member from a list ("Came in today with an ended plan or fees due", "Talk to these members")

steps.action: Under "Came in today with an ended plan or fees due" read "They checked in today. Ask them to renew or pay before they leave." and tap "Message" on a member
user_sees: The sheet "WhatsApp {member name}" opened on the message that fits (plan ended, fees due)
must_not: A birthday message for a fees reminder; the wrong member's sheet

user_sees: The member's chat with the words typed
must_not: The row vanishing from Today as if the message was surely sent

start: Today: a line under "Needs you" (a plan request, a number to confirm, someone who joined online)

user_sees: The page jumps to the card it is about (plan requests, joined online, numbers to confirm) or opens its page
must_not: A line that leads nowhere

steps.action: Decide it there (approve, make member, confirm)
user_sees: The line leaves "Needs you"; the bell still keeps it, marked "Done"
must_not: The line still on Today after it was dealt with; the same news shown again tomorrow

start: A brand-new gym with no records, and no internet

steps.action: Open Today in a gym with no members
user_sees: No number tiles yet; the join code card and the shop card; one set-up card at a time, not a wall of them
must_not: Tiles full of zeros and "NaN"; three set-up cards stacked

steps.action: Open Today with members but nothing due
user_sees: "Nobody to follow up" with "No plans are ending soon, and no plan ended in the last {days} days."; under "Losing the habit": "Start checking members in" until there are check-ins
must_not: An empty white gap where a list would be

steps.action: Turn the internet off, take a payment, open Today
user_sees: A line "{amount} in 1 payment taken on this device is waiting to send."
must_not: The waiting payment counted twice once it is sent; the line staying after it was sent

start: The same Today before and after things are done

steps.action: A member with fees due pays in full; go back to Today
user_sees: "Fees due" goes down by that amount and one member; "Today's collection" goes up by it; the member leaves "Money to collect"
must_not: Tiles that only change after a reload

user_sees: Both tiles go back
must_not: The cancelled money still in "Today's collection"

steps.action: Reply to a member message, or mark it done
user_sees: It leaves Today
must_not: A done item coming back on the next open

steps.action: Finish the set-up card that is showing
user_sees: The next set-up card takes its place, one at a time; none when all are done
must_not: A finished card shown again

start: Who sees which numbers on Today

steps.action: Compare Today as owner and as front desk
user_sees: Owner: money tiles and the week summary. Desk: people counts only
must_not: "Today's collection", "Fees due" in rupees or the week summary on a desk login

user_sees: It goes only where the owner sends it from his own WhatsApp
must_not: Any automatic send of the gym's money numbers

start: Today, signed in as front desk

user_sees: Title "Today" with the date; what waits for the desk on top; the quick-action buttons the owner chose
must_not: A quick-action button for an owner-only page

user_sees: People tiles only: "Active members", the four "Ending" tiles, "Expired", "Birthdays today", "Came in today", "Enquiries to call"
must_not: "Today's collection" or "Fees due" in rupees; an empty gap where they would be

user_sees: The register of today's check-ins
must_not: Money figures on the way

steps.action: Tap "Birthdays today", then the ready message for one of them
user_sees: The Members list of today's birthdays; the WhatsApp sheet with the birthday wish
must_not: A wish offered to a member whose birthday is not today

start: Today: a quick-action button, and "Message" on a member in a list

user_sees: The Add member form at once
must_not: The Members list with no form

steps.action: Under "Came in today with an ended plan or fees due" tap "Message" on a member
user_sees: The sheet "WhatsApp {member name}" with the fitting words
must_not: Another member's amount or date in the words

start: Money pages reached from Today by typed address

user_sees: "Only an owner can see this" with "Back to Today"
must_not: The "Money owed" list

user_sees: The Dues list of people, no collection total
must_not: Today's collection

user_sees: No "Last week at your gym" card
must_not: The week's money offered to the desk to share

start: Things waiting for the desk, before and after

steps.action: A member typed their number at the check-in poster: confirm it from Today
user_sees: The line leaves Today; the member shows "Using the app"
must_not: The same line back after a reload; the number joined to the wrong member

steps.action: Approve a member's plan request from Today, while the owner approves the same one on another device
user_sees: One decision stands and the other person is told, or sees it already decided
must_not: Two approvals, two changes to the plan

user_sees: "Came in today" goes up by one
must_not: A second check-in for the same member on the same day counted twice

start: What the desk sees of the gym on Today

user_sees: Counts of people and each member's own state
must_not: The gym's totals, profit or the week summary

steps.action: Read "Money to collect", if the desk gets that list (not read)
user_sees: At most each member's own due, which the desk must collect
must_not: A sum of all dues
